en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a hilly old town with brick houses and steep tiled roofs. In the foreground is a terrace-like building with neo‑Gothic windows and decorative balustrades, and behind it several larger brick structures and a square tower. A narrow street lined with houses descends to the right. In the distant background, a large arched steel bridge crosses a river. There is a handwritten-looking caption along the bottom edge and a small number on the right.
